title: Plan template validation and hashing

claims.text: validate_template enforces top-level shape, v equals 1, string safety, collection caps, duplicate id rejection and numeric bounds, raising bad_template on violations.
canonical_template_json emits sorted compact UTF-8 JSON without hash, and template_hash returns its SHA-256 digest.
load_template reads UTF-8 JSON and returns a normalized copy carrying hash, while resolve_template raises unknown_template for missing ids.

triggers: duplicate phase or task type id

decision.rule: Change here when plan template shape, caps, bounds or canonical hashing needs to change.
decision.failure: Valid templates are rejected, dangerous or cyclic structures are accepted, or normalized hashes mismatch.

questions.q: Where does validate_template enforce template shape and collection caps?
Where should I change the canonical template JSON and hash computation?
Where can I debug why a template fails with bad_template or unknown_template?
